publicationPolicy.summary: Only synthetic, reproducible benchmark evidence is published. Customer data and production traffic are never used.
publicationPolicy.isolation: The load generator, seed data and result storage run in a separate template-derived Railway project and are not part of the installable RustyAuth template.
publicationPolicy.promotion: A result becomes public only after its resource limits, dataset, workload, release commit, image digests and retained evidence pass catalogue validation.

programs.title: Single-realm capacity
programs.summary: Measures how many registered accounts, valid sessions, active authenticated users and passkey sign-ins one supported single-writer realm can serve within explicit latency and reliability gates.
schedule: A fixed-rate regression run after every release
A breakpoint ladder and one-hour soak once each month
A manual run after authentication, gateway, datastore or deployment changes

userProfiles.name: Light SaaS
userProfiles.description: Occasional account and session-backed application activity.

userProfiles.name: Typical application
userProfiles.description: A signed-in product session making a request about every ten seconds.

userProfiles.name: Heavy administration
userProfiles.description: An operator or workflow making sustained authenticated calls.

gates: Unexpected request failures below 0.1% and no unplanned 5xx responses
Authenticated reads below 250 ms p95 and 750 ms p99
Writes below 500 ms p95 and 1 second p99
No readiness loss, restart or out-of-memory event
Published user capacity retains 30% measured throughput headroom

programs.title: Fleet Analytics query qualification
programs.summary: Measures bounded organization-level Analytics queries at the pinned medium qualification tier.
schedule: Continuous assurance on the current main revision
Repeated before a supported release is promoted
gates: A 28-day organization query completes within 2 seconds p95 at the medium tier

reports.title: Medium-tier 28-day organization query
reports.environment: Pinned local SableDB and GreptimeDB topology
reports.summary: Twenty organization queries were measured after seeding 1,000 realms and 8,064,000 five-minute metric rows.
